author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Two cogs, each a hub ring with seven radial teeth, on a rising diagonal with 180-degree symmetry; they read as a pair of gears at 48 in both themes. Tooth spacing alternates 37 and 53 degrees (integer 3-4-5 directions).
omissions: Eighth tooth per gear (it would face the other gear within 8 units); separate hub circle is the ring's opening; the gears do not overlap as in the reference.
